regime_context: Hong Kong’s thematic rotation detector shows a narrow leadership with Tech Hardware & Semis (eligible, trending) just ahead of Diversified Miners (ineligible). Only 5 of 17 themes pass the trend gate; rotation breadth is contracting. No crowding extremes. The absolute-trend gate has historically helped cut drawdowns here, while cross-sectional momentum ranks have no predictive edge.

theses.subject: Tech Hardware & Semis

theses.dissent: Narrow leadership with only 5 eligible themes suggests fragility; the trend could quickly reverse to mean-reversion, causing whipsaw.
